calcValidTreeCoverLoss

Source: R/calcValidTreeCoverLoss.R
calcValidTreeCoverLoss.Rd

Observed annual tree cover loss by dominant driver, for model validation.

Usage

calcValidTreeCoverLoss(datasource = "GFW")

Arguments

datasource

Currently only "GFW" (WRI/Google DeepMind drivers of tree cover loss, Sims et al. 2025, crossed with UMD/Hansen annual loss via the GFW data-api).

Value

list of magpie object with data and weight

Details

This is UMD/Hansen tree cover loss, not FAO forest loss, with each 1 km cell assigned one dominant driver. All eight classes are returned, although only shifting cultivation reaches module 35 (f35_forest_lost_share): an order-of-magnitude and pattern check, not a target.

Author

Michael Crawford

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
calcOutput("ValidTreeCoverLoss", datasource = "GFW")
} # }
